witness.quote: Space for the vehicle on the opposite side of the railroad crossing
witness.reason: The intended at-grade crossing supports the opposite-side-space branch if physical insufficiency and its causal relationship to any halt are established.
required_context: Actual track and road profiles, vehicle dimensions, undercarriage geometry and available exit space.
Establish railroad identity, rail positions, crossing direction, actual road-track profiles, vehicle dimensions, trailing end and undercarriage geometry.
Opposite-side obstruction or occupancy with measured extent and timing, and evidence of any halt's cause.
Preserve prohibited-stopping exclusions and the unresolved interaction between necessary traffic-conflict avoidance and insufficient opposite-side space.
Rail locations, crossing direction and supported eventual crossing path; completion is not presumed.
Record downstream occupancy or obstruction extent and timing, available space, crossing motion and evidence linking any halt to its physical cause.
Retain the definition of completely cross: the trailing end is 15 feet or more past the nearest rail, without resolving nearest-rail selection for multiple tracks.
witness.subject_reason: An ordinary motor vehicle driven by a person in actual physical control falls within the supplied subject definitions.
